prose: Welcome to Inner Whirled, the new podcast with Dylan Saccoccio and Chance Garton, where we'll be providing deeply researched and well prepared podcasts on Spirit Whirled subjects, the language, symbolism, artifacts and system of the ancient universal priestcraft.

Episode 3 unveils the multidimensional symbolism connecting towers, bulls, divination, and the sun. Why are ancient gods and goddesses depicted with towers and forts as crowns? Who are the Tyrrhenian tower-builders? What does Hornism have to do with it all? This jam packed 2+ hour research show will give you the lens with which to see the fingerprints of the ancient universal empire.
